items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: we had a very warm friendship because he liked to play and practice, and I was always willing to practice and play with him. And we learned a lot from eachother.

ctx.x: So that your arrangements carried that flavor. Well, now Nat Towles' band, Buddy Tate was in that band, wasn't he?
Yes, Buddy Tate was the main featured soloist in that band.

items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: We had Charlie Christian, Sir Charles Thompson, Henry Coker Fred Beckett who died very young.

ctx.x: C.Q. Price, he's in Buffalo, Weldon Sneed Sir Charles Thompson, Walter Dunkins and Casey Smith, the guitar player.
